facts.text: The hotel is in Boston's Theatre District, seconds from performances at Boston Opera House and Wang Theatre.
facts.excerpt: Our location in the Theatre District puts you seconds from world-class Broadway performances at Boston Opera House and Wang Theatre.

facts.text: Guests can cross Boylston Street to explore Boston Common, the nation's oldest city park.
facts.excerpt: Cross Boylston Street to explore the nation's oldest city park at Boston Common

facts.text: The hotel's design is inspired by notorious Boston icons, from Aerosmith to Edgar Allan Poe to the Salem witches.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by notorious Boston icons, from Aerosmith to Edgar Allan Poe to the Salem “witches," W Boston is transforming the idea of traditional luxury.

facts.text: Room headboards are a playful distortion of early Colonial Boston's classic wood paneling.
facts.excerpt: The headboard is a playful distortion of early Colonial Boston‘s classic wood paneling

facts.text: Handmade wool area rugs in the rooms are inspired by Steven Tyler's jumpsuits.
facts.excerpt: Handmade wool area rugs are inspired by the energetic jumpsuits of Steven Tyler, one of Boston’s infamous rock & roll disruptors.

facts.text: Rooms have a cupboard stocked with local spirits.
facts.excerpt: The cupboard is stocked with local spirits to get the party going.

facts.text: The signature W bed has a featherbed mattress, floating frame and coffered headboard.
facts.excerpt: Slip into a signature W bed with a featherbed mattress, floating frame, and coffered headboard.

facts.text: The Urban Suite, themed on Edgar Allan Poe, is on the 15th floor and has hardwood floors throughout.
facts.excerpt: Situated on the 15th floor, this airy suite has stunning hardwood floors throughout the space for a luxe, urban feel.

facts.text: Penthouse II Suites offer views of downtown Boston from the corners of the highest floors.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in dynamic views of downtown Boston from the corners of our highest floors and amplify your stay with our state of the art entertainment system.

facts.text: W Lounge has a fireplace, creative small plates and rotating DJs on Thursday, Friday and Saturday nights.
facts.excerpt: featuring rotating DJs performing on Thursday, Friday and Saturday nights as well as eclectic signature cocktails accompanied by small bites.

facts.text: The Whatever/Whenever service aims to give guests whatever they want, whenever they want it.
facts.excerpt: W Boston’s Whatever/Whenever philosophy pampers guests with “whatever you want, whenever you want it,”
You’re invited—and your pet is too.

facts.text: The building meets LEED Gold standards.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
Rooms at W Boston do not have a fridge.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at W Boston do not have a fridge.
